name: Sistermon Ciel
main_effect:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Huckmon] in its name or [Royal Knight] trait among them to your hand. Trash the rest.
[All Turns] All of your Digimon with [Huckmon] in their names or [Royal Knight] trait gain ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.).
